name: Diane
greeting: I'm documenting this. I'm not necessarily SENDING it anywhere.

topics.label: Ask what she's writing
topics.goodText: She shows you a lightly redacted page. You're in it.

topics.label: Ask why she never reports anyone
topics.line: You never actually report anyone. Why?
topics.goodText: An honest, slightly vulnerable answer about who gets hurt by reports in this town.

topics.label: Ask about her part-time job
topics.goodText: She's quietly proud of it. Filing, at the town hall. Interesting.

topics.label: Ask about Sam and Baxter's antics
topics.line: Ever catch Sam and Baxter at anything?
topics.goodText: "I have never once successfully caught them. I have a whole log of failed attempts."
topics.badText: She thinks you're accusing her of being in on it.

hangouts: You 'observe' the town square with Diane. Her notes are better than any newspaper.
recruitText: "I'm documenting this." Pause. "From the inside, now."
